Reference / db/value

db/value#

Database values: what is bound to a statement and what a row holds.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

await db.execution("INSERT INTO users(name, age, nick) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
    DbText("Ada"), DbInteger(36), DbText(user.nickname));       // none binds NULL
DbDecimal(Decimal("9.50"));
DbBytes(data);
DbNull();

Description#

Database values: what is bound to a statement and what a row holds.

Values are always bound, never pasted into SQL. Each value object takes its plain type or a Maybe; none is SQL NULL. Rows are read by column with db/row's readers; a value shows itself to a DbValueWriting by calling the one callback of its kind.

object DbNull#

object DbNull does DbValue

The typed values bound to a statement (#188): DbInteger(7), DbText("Ada"), DbBoolean(true), DbFloating(1.5), DbDecimal(Decimal("9.50")), DbBytes(data) and DbNull(). Each also takes a Maybe, whose none binds SQL NULL: DbText(user.nickname).

object DbValueCapture#

object DbValueCapture does DbValueWriting

The print protocol: exactly one event of the declared kind, its value, then the capture is sealed. Flags: 1 started, 2 faulted, 4 poisoned, 8 sealed.

DbValueCapture.DbValueCapture#

DbValueCapture(kind is DbValueKind)

Expects one event of kind.

DbValueCapture.emit#

emit(kind is DbValueKind) is void

Records an event of kind; InvalidDbValue for a second event or another kind.

DbValueCapture.published#

published(value is native_db.DbCellState) is void

Writers publish a cell of the kind they emitted, so an accepted cell has the declared kind.
